Proof in the paper: The XRD patterns after ex-situ reduction exhibit prominent Ni (111) peaks at 44.5° 2θ for all measured Pt loadings and Pt (111) peaks at 39.8° 2θ for 0.4, 0.7, and 1.0 monolayer samples. Between the Pt (111) and Ni (111) peak a strong Ni-Pt alloy peak with an approximate 3 to 1 Ni/Pt ratio was observed.
